simplified_acquisition.commercial_ceilin: the highest dollar value of commercial acquisitions that may use the special procedures of Subpart 13.5, not counting the higher figure for acquisitions described in 13.500(c); write the amount as it appears in the text, for example $3 million
simplified_acquisition.special_ceiling: the higher dollar ceiling that applies to acquisitions described in 13.500(c); write the amount as it appears in the text, for example $3 million
ethics_clause.value_threshold: the contract value above which the Contractor Code of Business Ethics and Conduct clause must be inserted; write the amount as it appears in the text
hotline_poster.value_threshold: the contract value above which the Display of Hotline Poster(s) clause must be inserted; write the amount as it appears in the text
ethics_clause.performance_period: the minimum performance period of a contract for the ethics clause to apply; write only the number and unit as they appear in the text, without words such as 'or more', for example 90 days
device_records.minimum_retention: the minimum time that records required by the regulation must be retained, counted from release for commercial distribution; write only the number and unit as they appear in the text, for example 5 years
complaint_record.investigation_content: an item that the record of a complaint investigation must include about the investigation itself, such as when it happened and what it found; write the item exactly as it appears in the text but without a leading article such as 'The' or 'Any'
regulation_name.scope_title: what the regulation calls itself in its scope paragraph, in the phrase 'this ... regulation'; write the whole name including the word 'regulation' and anything in brackets after it, but without the word 'this'
